definition.strict: 1 - unclassified_total / extracted_total — every Step-1 reroute counts as a miss (most pessimistic)
definition.lenient: 1 - (truly_unknown + out_of_scope) / extracted_total — cross-layer reroute counts as covered
definition.in_scope: 1 - truly_unknown / (extracted_total - out_of_scope) — PAPER HEADLINE: out_of_scope items (PQC/RSA/profiled) are deliberately excluded by our scope, do NOT count against ontology completeness
